quarterly_data.quarter: Hirata Corporation semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-07-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026 (April-September 2025) consolidated results: net sales JPY 45,648 million (+13.1%), operating profit JPY 4,822 million (+74.4%), ordinary profit JPY 5,011 million (+85.0%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 3,437 million (+90.5%), on higher sales of production equipment for EVs and internal combustion engines and semiconductor wafer transfer equipment. Segments: automotive-related net sales JPY 22,134 million (+17.1%), operating profit JPY 3,248 million (+150.1%); other automated labor-saving equipment net sales JPY 5,979 million (-3.3%), operating profit JPY 465 million (prior-year operating loss). R&D expenses for the half were JPY 671 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 45,648 million (+13.1%); operating profit JPY 4,822 million (+74.4%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hirata Corporation semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-07-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor-related segment, first half (April-September 2025): net sales JPY 16,412,674 thousand (+15.8%), operating profit JPY 1,045 million (-42.0%). Management states sales held firm, centred on wafer transfer equipment, as generative AI-related orders continued, but profit fell year on year due to delayed price pass-through, higher warranty costs on some products and a revaluation of inventories.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor H1 net sales JPY 16,412,674 thousand (+15.8%); operating profit JPY 1,045 million (-42.0%)
